title: BPW-2026-0497
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0497
AFE – ASTM International
Bureau of Engineering and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $34,401 for encumbrance of funds for payment of renewal subscription for on-site license and online services and products for the period covering September 1, 2026 to September 1, 2027.
(AE27761106M, Fund 761 - Sewer Construction & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX78)
summary: Authority for Expenditure of $34,401 for renewal subscription to ASTM International on-site license and online services.
